charts.title: K2-417 b: orbits around K2-417
charts.description: The orbits of K2-417's planets in this map from above, to scale, with K2-417 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Incha et al. 2023 (2023MNRAS.523..474I), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname INCHA_ET_AL__2023): P 6.535 d

charts.title: K2-417 b: its transit
charts.description: K2-417 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 2 sectors (42, 92) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 49592509, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 54 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 1633 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 8-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 54 min early; 8-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 544 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
